## Type

- [ ] `feat` — new behaviour
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation
- [ ] `refactor` — no behaviour change
- [ ] `chore` — tooling, CI, dependencies

## Checklist

- [ ] Code and comments are in English
- [ ] `bash tests/run.sh` passes
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has a test
- [ ] Detection order and supported managers are unchanged, or the change
      is explained above
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` / version were **not** edited by hand (release-please
      handles them)
